metadata.title: Install a Fleximounts Overhead Storage Rack
metadata.description:
I show the steps to build and install a Fleximounts overhead storage rack.

Check out more information here  https://goo.gl/7UbGux.

We have more tips in our home improvement book https://amzn.com/B01MRGO8C5

nodes.plm_action: Install cross bars into garage ceiling
nodes.plm_caption: A man wearing blue jeans and a black shirt is demonstrating how to properly place the bottom portion of the wire shelving brackets in his garage. He talks about where to drill holes into the ceiling and shows how to use a level for accuracy. He then drills and places the shelf brackets on the top portion of the shelf and hangers that have been added to the garage.  He screws the shelf brackets into place and hangs a thin wire shelving basket. He is wearing yellow rubber gloves for the last few moments in the video.

summary.brief: A man installs a Fleximounts overhead storage rack in his garage.
summary.detailed: The video begins with the man using a stud finder to locate ceiling joists and marking two points three feet from each wall; he then drills 3/16‑inch pilot holes to a depth of about 2 3/8 inches and drives wood screws with an impact driver to attach the first ceiling bracket, repeating the process to install the remaining brackets four feet apart and secured to two joists each. Back on the floor he assembles the rack by bolting the lower vertical posts to the upper posts, adjusting the height between 22 and 40 inches, adds the top bar over the lower bar and secures it with a nut and bolt, and installs the center straps. Using two ladders he lifts the assembled frame, hooks it onto the ceiling brackets, and bolts the corners and center into place; finally he lowers a horizontal bar of the rack and releases it, showing the completed overhead storage system.

action.detailed: Locate the joists, mark and pre‑drill holes, drive screws to mount ceiling brackets, assemble the vertical posts and top bar with bolts, lift the assembled frame onto the brackets using ladders, and secure all connections with bolts.
action.actor: a man wearing blue jeans and a black shirt (later wearing yellow rubber gloves)

nodes.plm_action: Measuring distance between center of ceiling panels
nodes.plm_caption: A man explains how to install a television wall mount. The man measures the height of a garage ceiling, removes the 3 inch wood studs in the ceiling, then screws the brackets into the ceiling stud.

summary.brief: A man installs the ceiling brackets and begins assembling the overhead storage rack.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the man using a stud finder to locate the ceiling joists and marking the center points three feet from each wall. He measures the spacing for the brackets, marking positions four feet apart for the second and third brackets. He then drills 3/16‑inch pilot holes about two‑and‑three‑eighths inches deep at each mark, using a drill with a hex‑bottom bit. With an impact driver and a socket wrench he drives wood screws through the ceiling brackets, making sure the inside corners of each bracket face each other. After the three brackets are secured to the joists, he starts to connect the lower vertical posts to the upper posts, bolting them together and adjusting the height. Throughout the process he climbs a step ladder, handles the drill and measuring tools, and checks alignment before tightening each fastener.

action.detailed: Locate joist centers with a stud finder, mark the bracket positions, drill pilot holes, drive wood screws to secure the brackets to the joists, then begin attaching the vertical posts and top bar, using a ladder, drill, impact driver, and measuring tape.
action.actor: A man wearing a black shirt, glasses, and blue jeans

nodes.plm_action: Attach metal rods to ceiling using screws
nodes.plm_caption:
A man demonstrates how to mount equipment to a garage ceiling using long metal components with holes in them. First he starts by hanging the components on the ceiling and then he begins to add other components.
The man sits on the floor surrounded with pieces of equipment and other tools before he stands up to start installing equipment to the ceiling. He uses a measuring tape to measure the ceiling before installing them. He uses a pair of gloves while installing the rack to prevent scratching.
The camera first looks down on the man from his point of view and then shifts to a higher angle looking down on the man as he works. A bright light shines over the man and equipment.

summary.brief: Man assembles and installs an overhead metal storage rack in his garage.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the man seated on the garage floor surrounded by metal brackets, vertical posts, bolts, a measuring tape and yellow gloves. He measures and marks the ceiling where the rack will be anchored, then climbs a ladder to line up and fasten the ceiling brackets to the joists. He connects the lower vertical posts to the upper posts with bolts, adjusting the height between 22 and 40 inches, and slides the top bar over the lower bar, securing it with a nut and bolt. Two center straps are positioned at the same height and fixed in place. He inserts the first vertical post into the center of the ceiling bracing, aligns it with the brackets, and repeats the step on the opposite side. Using two ladders he lifts the partially assembled frame, hooks it onto the vertical supports, and tightens additional bolts and connecting plates to lock the corners. The camera switches between his point‑of‑view and higher angled shots, showing the well‑lit garage workspace. In the final seconds he lowers a horizontal bar attached to the rack and releases it.

action.brief: Assemble and install overhead storage rack
action.detailed: Attach the ceiling brackets to the joists, bolt the vertical posts together, secure the top bar and center straps, lift the assembled frame onto the brackets using ladders, and fasten all connections with bolts and plates.
action.actor: The man wearing a black shirt, blue jeans and yellow gloves

nodes.plm_action: Determining the location of the ceiling jois
nodes.plm_caption:
A man is demonstrating how to install track on a garage ceiling. He shows how to measure and mark the area for the track, how to drill the ceiling, and how to run the track over that area. He starts by removing some things from a cardboard box and explaining the parts and what is needed. He goes to the ceiling and shows how to measure and mark the area for the track. He then shows how to drill the ceiling, but he skips the drilling. He then goes on to run the track over that area. He holds the track up, talks about it for a few seconds and then lays it on the ground. He talks about the drill and where to place it.
The background has many different tools and equipment.
The man is wearing glasses, a black shirt and blue jeans. The cardboard box has black and white writing on it. It also has a few drawings on the front that he puts down before he gets to the ceiling.
It is daytime in the room, and the outside is slightly sunny through the window. There are many different objects in the background including ladders, shovels, bags, windows, a ladder with tools and equipment on it, and a red chair.

summary.brief: A man measures, marks, and positions a ceiling track while preparing it for installation.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the presenter kneeling beside a large Fleximounts cardboard box, unpacking the components. He then stands, picks up a stud finder and a measuring tool, and locates the ceiling joists, drawing a straight line where the track will run. Although he explains how to drill pilot holes, no drilling is shown in this segment. He lifts the long metal ceiling track, holds it up to demonstrate its length and alignment, and runs it along the marked line before setting the track on the floor. In the final moments he holds a screw and a drill, gesturing to where the drill will be used. Throughout, he wears glasses, a black shirt, and blue jeans, and the cluttered garage background is filled with ladders, tools, and a window that lets in daylight.

action.detailed: Measure the joist locations, mark a straight line on the ceiling, lift the metal track, align it over the marked line, and place the track on the floor while discussing the upcoming drilling.
action.actor: A man wearing glasses, a black shirt, and blue jeans

nodes.plm_action: Measure distance from light fixtures on ceiling using tape measure
nodes.plm_caption:
In this video, a man demonstrates how to install a track on a ceiling. The video is sped up for context but then sped back down to normal. First, he drills into a small hole in a white ceiling while standing on a metal step ladder and is holding the drill with both hands. Then, he goes down a step ladder and holds a small flat drill bit in his left hand while holding the drill with his right and talks about the process. He climbs back up the ladder holding the drill bit up in the air and an empty drill bit in his left hand. He then places a long piece of track into the ceiling as he is talking and gesturing with both hands. He then goes back down the ladder. He repeats the process once more.

At the end, he holds up the drill to the camera, puts the small flat drill bit in the front portion of the drill, and screws the top of the track against the ceiling. He finishes by pulling the track down from the ceiling using his left hand.

summary.brief: A man installs a ceiling track and its brackets by drilling, positioning, and fastening them while working from a step ladder.
summary.detailed: The man climbs a metal step ladder and uses a cordless drill to make a small hole in the white ceiling, then descends to change to a flat drill bit. He climbs back up, lifts a long metal track, aligns it with the hole and secures the top of the track to the ceiling by driving screws with the drill. After fastening the first segment, he repeats the drilling and attachment for a second section and then pulls the track down to its final position. Continuing on the ladder, he measures the spacing between brackets, pushes each bracket into the ceiling, and finally tightens all bracket screws with the drill, completing the installation.

action.detailed: Climb the step ladder, drill a hole in the ceiling, change to the appropriate bit, position the metal track, screw the track into place, pull it down, then measure, place, and fasten each bracket with the drill.
action.actor: A man wearing a black shirt, glasses, and blue jeans, working from a metal step ladder

nodes.plm_action: Attaching metal plates to ceiling using screws
nodes.plm_caption: A man demonstrates how to install a bracket on a ceiling. He is using tools such as wrenches. He has to use a ladder to install the bracket. There is a yellow mop bucket visible in the video. At the end of the video, he stands on a ladder next to the bracket and says he will come back and show you how to hang it. There is white cloth on the floor next to the man. In the background of the video is white wall, many tools and ladders visible in background.

summary.brief: The man assembles and installs ceiling brackets for an overhead storage rack.
summary.detailed: The video begins with the man seated on the garage floor surrounded by metal brackets, screws and tools. He picks up L‑shaped brackets, shows their correct orientation, and uses a screwdriver and power drill to tighten screws while explaining the parts. He then assembles longer shelf brackets, aligns holes, and secures bolts with a wrench. After measuring and marking the desired locations on the ceiling, he climbs a step ladder, holds each bracket against a joist and drives the mounting screws with a drill, tightening the bolts with a wrench. He repeats the process for the remaining brackets, adjusts the vertical posts, and checks that the assemblies are level. Near the end he stands on the ladder, inspects the installed brackets and prepares to hang the storage frame later. The background shows white walls, a yellow mop bucket, ladders and assorted garage tools.

action.detailed: Secure the overhead‑storage rack brackets to the ceiling joists by marking the positions, climbing a ladder, and fastening them with screws and bolts using a drill and wrenches.
action.actor: A man in a black polo shirt, blue jeans, glasses and later yellow gloves, working in a garage

nodes.plm_action: Lowering metal shelf down from ceiling using metal track system
nodes.plm_caption: In a room, a man is standing on the left. He places his left hand on a horizontal horizontal metal bar, 2 feet off the ground, held by vertical metal bars, about 6 feet from his hand. The man stands facing the camera, facing the bar. The man lowers the horizontal bar slowly. He releases the horizontal bar. The room is well lit.

summary.brief: A man on a step ladder lowers a horizontal metal bar of the ceiling rack.
summary.detailed: In a well‑lit garage the man, wearing a black shirt and blue jeans, stands on a step ladder at the left side of the frame and faces the camera. He reaches out with his left hand, grasps a horizontal metal bar that is about two feet above the floor and supported by vertical metal posts roughly six feet away, and slowly pulls the bar downward until it settles lower on the supports. He then releases his grip, letting the bar remain in its lowered position.

action.detailed: While perched on a step ladder, the man grips the horizontal bar with his left hand, pulls it down smoothly until it rests lower on the vertical supports, and then lets go.
action.actor: the man in a black shirt and blue jeans standing on a step ladder

nodes.plm_action: Measuring ceiling distance with a stud finder
nodes.plm_caption: A man holds a pencil. He then picks up a measuring tool, points out marks on the ceiling and shows how to place a long metal bracket.

summary.brief: A man prepares the garage ceiling for a Fleximounts overhead rack by locating joists, marking reference lines, and positioning a long metal bracket.
summary.detailed: The video begins with the man kneeling beside a large Fleximounts cardboard box in a cluttered garage. He stands, holds a pencil and a ruler, and moves to a step ladder where he uses a stud‑finder in one hand, points to detected joist locations with the other, then repeats the process with the stud‑finder switched to the opposite hand and with a second device. He slides a long, flat metal piece across the ceiling to show where a rack bracket will sit. Next, he draws a straight line on the ceiling with the pencil, using the metal adjustment block as a guide, and measures the distance from existing ceiling fixtures. He then holds a track‑light against the ceiling, lowers it to demonstrate the mounting position, and finally draws a final line indicating where a mounting hole should be drilled, ending with a thumbs‑up while standing beside the ladder.

action.detailed: Locate joist positions with a stud‑finder, slide a long metal bracket across the ceiling, measure distances with a ruler and pencil, draw reference lines where the overhead rack brackets will be mounted, and indicate the final hole location.
action.actor: A man wearing a black shirt and blue jeans standing in a garage workshop

Throughout the segment the garage backdrop includes a silver ladder, a red ladder, a window of block panes, and assorted tools and storage items.

action.detailed: Using a cordless drill and impact driver, the man measures the spacing, aligns each metal bracket with the ceiling marks, and drives wood screws to secure the brackets while working from a ladder.

nodes.plm_action: Measuring distance between ceiling joist and ceiling grid
nodes.plm_caption:
This is a demonstration video on assembling a black metal frame. The man, standing in front of a garage background, is demonstrating how to assemble the frame from the bottom (sitting on the floor) and from the ceiling using a ladder. The video is very well lit, and is very well done.
The man wearing glasses, a black polo shirt and blue jeans, kneels on one knee on the floor, holding up a black metal frame in front of him while facing forward. He talks and makes hand gestures, and we then see him standing up in front of a garage window, holding a silver item, and a measuring tape in his left hand, and then places his right hand on the ceiling.  We see him sitting on the floor again with the frame in front of him and he then picks up the frame and fits in the holes with his right hand and points out a part.
We then see him standing up holding a white shelf-like item. He talks, he holds a black metal frame attached to the ceiling with both hands, he points and uses his left hand to move the frame slightly. He places his right hand behind the ceiling, holds up the black metal frame, brings it down, and then points and points down, first with one hand, and then with two. We then see him kneeling on the floor next to a white grid work frame with the same black frame pieces. He removes his right hand, and we see his right hand making an "L" shape, with his two hands on the frame.
We then see him standing in front of the frame attached to the ceiling. He talks while holding the frame on the ceiling with one hand, and his other hand moving back and forth on the frame, he points and brings both hands closer to each other, he moves slightly back, and holds onto the frame on the ceiling in front of him. The video is well lit and well done, and the man seems a bit haphazard in his movements but knows what he's doing. He is wearing a black polo shirt and has the sleeve pushed up, his forearms and hands are seen clearly. The video plays at a good pace, and we can see a few different parts of the frame lying on the floor, as well as two ladder frames hanging on the wall.
The man, wearing yellow gloves, stands next to a ladder, holding up a black metal frame, and brings it down and places it on the ladder. He has his hand on the frame on the ceiling, and we see him leaning and looking up, then moving his left hand away from the frame.

summary.brief: The man assembles a black metal frame on the floor and then mounts it to the garage ceiling using a ladder.
summary.detailed: Kneeling on the floor, the man lifts a black metal frame and demonstrates how the pieces fit together, pointing out the holes and connecting parts. He then stands, measures the ceiling with a tape, and climbs a step ladder. From the ladder he holds the assembled frame up to the ceiling, lines the frame’s holes with the ceiling brackets, inserts the frame into place, and repeatedly adjusts it by moving his hands, pointing, and shifting the frame to ensure a proper fit. Throughout the segment he alternates between sitting on the floor to handle components and standing on the ladder to position the frame, while wearing glasses, a black polo shirt, blue jeans, and yellow gloves.

action.detailed: Raise the black metal frame, align its holes with the ceiling brackets, insert the frame into the brackets, and adjust it for a secure fit while standing on a ladder.
action.actor: A man wearing a black polo shirt, glasses, blue jeans, and yellow gloves

summary_sent_to_llm.title: Install a Fleximounts Overhead Storage Rack
summary_sent_to_llm.description:
I show the steps to build and install a Fleximounts overhead storage rack.

Check out more information here  https://goo.gl/7UbGux.

We have more tips in our home improvement book https://amzn.com/B01MRGO8C5
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video begins with the man using a stud finder to locate ceiling joists and marking two points three feet from each wall; he then drills 3/16‑inch pilot holes to a depth of about 2 3/8 inches and drives wood screws with an impact driver to attach the first ceiling bracket, repeating the process to install the remaining brackets four feet apart and secured to two joists each. Back on the floor he assembles the rack by bolting the lower vertical posts to the upper posts, adjusting the height between 22 and 40 inches, adds the top bar over the lower bar and secures it with a nut and bolt, and installs the center straps. Using two ladders he lifts the assembled frame, hooks it onto the ceiling brackets, and bolts the corners and center into place; finally he lowers a horizontal bar of the rack and releases it, showing the completed overhead storage system.
action_list: Assemble and install overhead storage rack
Demonstrate drill grip and position bracket
Point to box and lift tool
assemble and mount overhead metal grid storage rack
Mark and start attaching ceiling bracket
Measure and point to ceiling brackets
Insert rectangular bar into grid slots
